raw_response:
This is my home plot, close to the house, so I take care with it. I am in FISP this year — I got coupons for one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, so I will put fertilizer on the maize. I also carry manure from the goats to add to the soil. I planted hybrid seed from the agro-dealer with the seed coupon, and I intercrop with pigeon pea so I do not need to spray. The rains come well in Dedza so there is no need to irrigate. Most of the work I do myself with my wife, and at weeding time I may call one or two people for a day or two of ganyu.
